summary: CI pipeline (#67) is functionally complete and merged in main (PR #236). No critical or blocking issues; only minor efficiency/clarity notes.

findings.description: playwright.config.ts comment (line 39-41) claims 'CI runs next build + next start' but the webServer command is hardcoded to 'pnpm dev'. Comment is misleading; behavior works.

Coverage step duplicates work: line 64 runs 'pnpm test' (all workspace tests), then line 67 runs 'pnpm --filter @repo/web run test -- --coverage' which re-runs the web tests. Could be consolidated to a single coverage-enabled run.

No 'pnpm build' step — CI verifies lint/typecheck/test but never the production Next.js build. tsc --noEmit catches most issues, but build-time errors (next-config validation, MDX, server-component constraints) would only surface on Vercel.

node_modules cache key is based only on lockfile hash and caches workspace node_modules folders. For pnpm a more effective strategy is caching the pnpm store directory (~/.local/share/pnpm/store or 'pnpm config get store-dir'). Works as-is, just slower restores on cache miss.
E2E job gates on 'github.ref == refs/heads/main && github.event_name == push' — PRs never run E2E. Deliberate trade-off (faster PRs) but breakages only surface post-merge.
